short_title: Gonzaga to Cosimo, Sablo 24 Jan 1439 (MAP XI c. 215); sibling 2947 = MAP XI images 691-694, 31 Dec 1439, glossed

matters: Sforza writes Cosimo a two-page cipher letter from Lodi weeks after the Peace of Lodi (9 Apr 1454) and before Florence joined the new league (30 Aug 1454); the cipher would show the Milan-Florence terms being settled.
